name: io.github.vish288/mcp-atlassian-extended
description: MCP server for Jira and Confluence — sprints, agile boards, attachments, versions, calendars.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Jira Cloud account email. With JIRA_API_TOKEN this takes precedence over any token below.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Jira Cloud API token, used with JIRA_USERNAME (basic auth)

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_PAT
environmentVariables.description: Jira personal access token for Data Center (aliases: JIRA_PERSONAL_TOKEN, JIRA_TOKEN). Ignored when JIRA_USERNAME and JIRA_API_TOKEN are both set.

environmentVariables.name: CONFLUENCE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Confluence instance URL (optional, for Confluence tools). Cloud URLs usually need the /wiki suffix.

environmentVariables.name: CONFLUENCE_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Confluence Cloud account email. With CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN this takes precedence over any token below.

environmentVariables.name: CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Confluence Cloud API token, used with CONFLUENCE_USERNAME (basic auth)

environmentVariables.name: CONFLUENCE_PAT
environmentVariables.description: Confluence personal access token for Data Center (aliases: CONFLUENCE_PERSONAL_TOKEN, CONFLUENCE_TOKEN). Confluence tools also require the Team Calendars add-on.
